crossRefs.note: But Zion said, “Yahweh has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me.”
“Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may…
For Yahweh has called you as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off,” says…
“Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, so that no one passed through you, I will make you an eternal excellency, a…
For Yahweh will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake, because it has pleased Yahweh to make you a people…
Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions…
“Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
“Don’t consider what this people has spoken, saying, ‘Has Yahweh cast off the two families which he chose?’ Thus they…
Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up…
I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the…
God didn’t reject his people, which he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads…
But I said, “I have labored in vain. I have spent my strength in vain for nothing; yet surely the justice due to me is…
“As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter
For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right:
You have wearied Yahweh with your words. Yet you say, ‘How have we wearied him?’ In that you say, ‘Everyone who does…
Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?
I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from Yahweh, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God?”
translations.bsb: Why do you say, O Jacob, and why do you assert, O Israel, “My way is hidden from the LORD, and my claim is ignored by my God”?
translations.kjv: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the LORD, and my judgment is passed over from my God?
translations.asv: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from Jehovah, and the justice due to me is passed away from my God?
